title: Cheeseburger Hamburger Helper from Scratch
description: A homemade version of cheeseburger hamburger helper, quick and easy to prepare, inspired by a social media post.

ingredients.item: ground beef, chopped aggressively or as preferred
A healthy splash of pickle juice
Slices of cheddar cheese, as needed
Optional: bacon bits, for added flavor

steps: Cook ground beef until browned, crispy, and no longer gray. Drain excess grease.
Add mustard, ketchup, pickle juice, diced onion, garlic salt, pepper, and tomato paste to the beef. Stir well.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a simmer.
Add egg noodles, cover, and simmer on medium heat until noodles are cooked and liquid is absorbed.
Stir in shredded cheese and sliced cheddar cheese until melted and cheesy.
Optional: add bacon bits for extra flavor.
Serve hot and enjoy your homemade cheeseburger hamburger helper.
notes:
Feel free to customize with additional ingredients like bacon bits or different cheeses for variation.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/19eRRW4vZs/
